_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture - a GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones response as GithubApiMilestone[]. Never captured from a real repository. Note the response is a BARE ARRAY: unlike /search/issues there is no envelope and no total_count, which is why list_github_milestones emits `truncated` instead of `totalCount`. Deliberately awkward: see _quirks. Consumed by nothing today; see ../../overview.md.

_quirks.no-envelope: The real payload is the array below, not this object. The wrapper exists only to carry _comment and _quirks; a consumer must read `milestones`.
_quirks.no-total: GitHub sends no total_count and no incomplete_results here. There is nothing to map to totalCount - see ../../../04-contracts/github-api.md#listing-milestones.
_quirks.milestone-3: The ordinary case: description and due_on both set, work still open.
_quirks.milestone-2: state closed with closed_at set, and open_issues 0 - closed AND complete.
_quirks.milestone-1: state closed with open_issues 3 still outstanding. Closed does NOT mean delivered; the state description says so.
_quirks.milestone-4: description and due_on are both explicitly null - the compact shape must carry null through, not omit the keys.
_quirks.numbering: These numbers are the MILESTONE sequence. Milestone 3 is unrelated to issue 3 in issue-list.json, which is the trap both milestone tool descriptions warn about.
